payload.text: Morning pulses through The Wilds, cheerful and expectant. I see 10 travelers sharing their day. Ridge Handsteady, a skilled explorer, moves with purpose not far away. Clouds creep across the sky, rolling and draped. Autumn cloaks the land in fire and bronze.
